//: Markup-fidelity fixture for the PROGRESS-GROUP component — the labeled progress block pa-progress-group (keen `DataViz.progress_group/1`, svelte `display/ProgressGroup.svelte`). SCOPE = CONTAINER SHELL + LABEL ROW only; the BAR child is DEFERRED to the progress fixture. Both wrappers are SLOT-COMPOSED: svelte's ProgressGroup always takes the bar through its `children` slot; keen's progress_group takes an `inner_block` slot that OVERRIDES its auto-built <.progress> bar (keen was aligned to svelte in this slice — it previously ALWAYS inlined the bar with no way to override). The shared goldens pass an EMPTY bar slot to both, so each emits exactly the container + label row (span label + span.pa-progress__label-value) and the bar is left out — the diffable shell both agree on. The real bar (svelte-slotted / keen-auto-or-slotted) is the progress fixture's territory; keen's auto-bar FALLBACK + slot OVERRIDE are both locked by keen's data_viz_test.exs. Authored from dist/css/main.css + demo/views/data-visualization.mustache + _data-viz.scss.

propsVocabulary.label: the label text shown on the left of the label row (a bare <span>)
propsVocabulary.valueText: the value text shown on the right of the label row (pa-progress__label-value), e.g. "65%". keen auto-derives it as `<%= @value %>%` from the numeric `value`; svelte takes it verbatim via valueText. Scenarios set it to the matching N% so both wrappers agree.
propsVocabulary.value: the numeric 0-100 that keen feeds its (slot-overridable) auto-bar (aria-valuenow + --value) — the BAR is DEFERRED (the progress fixture's territory). Provided so keen's required attr is satisfied; not asserted by the shell golden.
propsVocabulary.body: the bar slot — passed EMPTY by every scenario so both wrappers emit the shell only (svelte renders an empty children slot; keen's empty-but-present inner_block slot OVERRIDES its auto-bar, leaving the bar out). The real bar is deferred to the progress fixture.
propsVocabulary.extraClass: extra classes appended verbatim — class passthrough, not a core feature

features.//: Feature→class contract authored from dist/css/main.css. The pa-progress-group BLOCK has ZERO modifiers (grep '\.pa-progress-group--' is empty). Its visible classes are the label-row elements pa-progress__label / pa-progress__label-value — which live in the pa-progress block namespace and are DEFERRED here (see deferred): the shell golden exercises them directly. label/valueText/value/extraClass produce null (text / deferred / passthrough).

value.note: numeric for keen's (slot-overridable) auto-bar — DEFERRED (progress fixture); not asserted by the shell

body.note: bar slot — passed empty so both wrappers emit the shell only; the real bar is deferred to progress

extraClass.note: class passthrough — appended verbatim, not a core feature

deferred.//: The label-row element classes live in the pa-progress block namespace (not pa-progress-group__*), and the inlined/slotted BAR itself is the pa-progress component's territory. The shell goldens below EXERCISE the two label-row classes directly (so compare proves them); they are listed here only to document that they belong to pa-progress, and the bar element classes are covered by the `progress` fixture. pa-progress__label / __label-value are exercised by this fixture's goldens; the fill/bar are deferred to progress.
deferred.pa-progress__label: Label row above the bar — EXERCISED by this fixture's shell goldens (listed for provenance; it is a pa-progress-namespace element reused by the group).
deferred.pa-progress__label-value: Right-hand value span in the label row — EXERCISED by this fixture's shell goldens.

scenarios.name: basic
scenarios.note: Shell + label row. keen inlines a pa-progress bar after the label row (deferred to progress); svelte slots it (empty here). The shared contract is the shell above.
